product_summary: Website skywinpolypack.com (Morbi, Gujarat; GST 24ADZFS8117J1ZC, PAN ADZFS8117J) lists: White Roll PP Woven Fabric, PP Woven Fabric Roll, White PP Woven Fabric Roll, PP Fabric Roll, Woven Fabric Roll, Polypropylene Woven Sack Roll, PP Woven Sacks Roll, PP Woven Sacks, Laminated PP Woven Sack/Bag, Polypropylene Woven Sacks. Stated applications: packaging of textiles, coils, tyres, machinery, polymers. No rigid plastic items, no injection-moulded or sheet/film products, no textile garments.

Trader signs present alongside own production, so manufacturer_trader rather than pure manufacturer.
comment: HS mapping vs declared codes: 540720 — exact match, this is the core line (PP/HDPE woven fabric in rolls, uncoated/laminated). 630533 — exact match for PP woven sacks/bags (strip-based). 392329 — partial/overlapping: applies only to the laminated PP woven sack/bag line if classified as plastics sacks; the same goods are more naturally 630533, so the two codes are partly duplicative. 392690 — wrong/unsubstantiated: no residual 'other plastics article' product appears anywhere on the site; likely a catch-all filler code. Industry misclassification: declared industry 'Строительство и DIY' (construction & DIY) does not fit — actual business is flexible industrial packaging (PP/HDPE woven fabric and sacks) for textiles, coils, tyres, machinery and polymer packaging; should be reclassified to packaging/technical textiles. Product lines missing from the declaration: none obvious — the declared set covers fabric (540720) and sacks (630533/392329); however the declaration omits any distinct code for laminated/coated woven fabric (e.g. 5903-type coated textile or 3921 if plastic-coated), which the site explicitly sells as 'Laminated PP Woven Sack/Bag'. All product claims are from the company's own website (home page and company-profile page) — no customs line or B-L record was checked in this task, therefore every product line is 'заявлено, не подтверждено'. Per project rule 3, the HS discrepancies (392690 unsupported, 392329 duplicative) are not grounds for rejection: company retained, codes corrected to 540720 + 630533 as primary, 392329 as conditional, 392690 to be dropped unless a concrete plastics-article line is evidenced. No registry, revenue or shipment-volume research performed (out of scope for this role).
